title: Foliar silicate raises field yield under drought
statement: Foliar silicate treatment increases grain yield of drought-stressed wheat in field conditions. The effect is large enough and repeatable enough to justify a field trial, and the mechanism reported in controlled studies transfers to field-grown wheat.

title: The yield benefit does not transfer to the field
statement: Foliar silicate treatment does not increase grain yield of drought-stressed wheat in the field. The positive results come from greenhouse or model-organism work that does not transfer, and field trials show no yield benefit.

title: The evidence cannot decide the field question
statement: Existing evidence cannot determine whether foliar silicate increases field grain yield under drought. Some controlled studies report benefits, field results are mixed or null, and the decisive field comparison has not been made.
